title: "Overview"

# Literature Radar

A date-based archive of new papers from the journals you follow. Each journal has its own update history, and every update remains available even if that journal is no longer monitored.

~~~{r}
source("../R/site.R")
site <- load_literature_site_data("..")
~~~ 

~~~{r, results='asis'}
stats <- list(
  c(label = "Papers indexed", value = format(site$paper_count, big.mark = ",")),
  c(label = "Journals in archive", value = as.character(length(site$journals))),
  c(label = "Retrieval updates", value = as.character(site$report_count)),
  c(label = "AI summaries", value = as.character(site$summary_count))
)
cat('<div class="stats-grid">')
for (stat in stats) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">%s</div><div class="stat-label">%s</div></div>',
    site_html_escape(stat[["value"]]), site_html_escape(stat[["label"]])
  ))
}
cat('</div>')
if (nzchar(site$latest_update)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<p class="last-updated">Most recent update: %s</p>',
    site_html_escape(site_format_timestamp(site$latest_update))
  ))
}
~~~

## Journals

Select a journal to browse its update history. Updates are ordered by the date they were generated, with the newest first. Journals that are no longer monitored remain in the archive.

~~~{r, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="journal-grid">')
for (journal in site$journals) {
  latest <- journal$latest_report
  if (is.null(latest)) {
    update_line <- "No successful update yet"
    window_line <- ""
    progress_line <- ""
  } else {
    update_line <- paste0("Last update: ", site_format_timestamp(latest$generated_at_utc))
    window_line <- paste0(
      "PubMed Create Date window: ",
      site_format_date(latest$start_date), " – ", site_format_date(latest$end_date)
    )
    summary_date <- if (nzchar(latest$latest_summary_at)) {
      site_format_timestamp(latest$latest_summary_at)
    } else {
      "Summaries pending"
    }
    progress_line <- paste0(
      latest$article_count, " papers · ",
      latest$summary_count, " summaries · latest summary: ", summary_date
    )
  }

  status <- if (isTRUE(journal$enabled)) {
    '<span class="journal-status monitoring">Monitoring</span>'
  } else {
    '<span class="journal-status inactive">Not currently monitored</span>'
  }
  slug <- site_slug(journal$id)
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<article class="journal-tile">',
      '<h3><a href="journals/%s.html">%s</a></h3>',
      '%s',
      '<p>%s</p>',
      '<p>%s</p>',
      '<p class="journal-progress">%s</p>',
      '<a href="journals/%s.html">View update history →</a>',
      '</article>'
    ),
    site_html_escape(slug),
    site_html_escape(journal$name),
    status,
    site_html_escape(update_line),
    site_html_escape(window_line),
    site_html_escape(progress_line),
    site_html_escape(slug)
  ))
}
cat('</div>')
~~~
